## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, what changes for the user, and any scope limits.
Link the issue or task when available.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Distinguish local checks from hosted CI and note
anything not run. Include focused screenshots only when they help review a UI change.

## Review notes

- [ ] Important behavior and failure paths have meaningful coverage.
- [ ] Ownership, untrusted input and saved-work behavior were considered.
- [ ] Tests use fictional data and mock AI; no credentials or candidate data are included.
- [ ] Schema/API changes include reviewed migrations, contracts and recovery notes, if applicable.
- [ ] Documentation, changelog and project status reflect material changes.

Note compatibility changes, rollout requirements and remaining risks, or say none.
